comment.body:
Please retest one harmless delete-and-recreate Send text shortcut on the current PowerToys build. If output from the deleted mapping returns, please provide:
1. A sanitized before/after Keyboard Manager configuration containing only the relevant entries.
2. A fresh diagnostic archive by commenting /bugreport immediately after reproducing.
This will distinguish persisted migration data from transient engine state.
